maya: Quick sync: defining the alpha "onramp manifest" for private deploys where customers control networking. Need compact deliverable for field + checklist for launch gates.
nikhil: We should keep the manifest machine-friendly + human readable. One JSON payload + one page runbook.
evie: Agreed. Minimum fields: preset name, required_customer_steps, expected_egress_behavior, smoke_tests, contacts.
lee: Security: include 'artifact_signature' and 'kms_instructions' keys for airgap installs. Also mark which telemetry endpoints require allowlist entries.
nikhil: For alpha presets propose: "vpc-keep-egress", "vpc-basic", "airgap-lite". vpc-keep-egress = preserve announced prefixes and static egress per-cluster.
maya: Launch gates draft: 1) Manifest + runbook published and accepted by field, 2) Egress preservation validated in two customer environments, 3) Fast rollback tested end-to-end (operator revert + routing restore <20m), 4) Security sign-off on offline artifact signatures.
evie: Add: monitoring dashboards exist (egress-change alert, per-tenant latency).
